items.name: Alchemist's Fire (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate A Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 2d8 fire damage, 2 persistent fire damage, and 2 fire splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Hatchet
items.description: This small axe can be used in close combat or thrown.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

defensiveAbilities.name: Evasion
defensiveAbilities.description: When the commando rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Spurred by Death
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet reduces a creature to 0 HP

Effect The commando Interacts to draw a weapon, Steps, Strides, or uses Hunt Prey.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cruel Cutter
offensiveAbilities.description: Burning Mammoth commandos ably carve flesh and wood with their axes. An axe the commando uses gains the reach trait and deals an additional 1d6 damage (included in the hatchet Strikes above).

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunt Prey
offensiveAbilities.description: The commando designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey. The commando gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek their prey and to Survival checks to Track their prey. The first time the commando hits their designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d8 precision damage. The commando also ignores the penalty for making ranged attacks within the second range increment when attacking their prey. These effects last until the commando uses Hunt Prey again.
